paragraphs: The Blackwood Archer is the Tupi unique foot archer in Age of Empires. With a great wooden bow and a distinctive feathered silhouette, this lightly protected warrior relies on arrows and distance to survive.
A gathered force can fill the battlefield with volleys, but enemies that close the gap threaten these fragile archers.

Blackwood Archers are trained in pairs and use less population space than ordinary soldiers. Their strength grows when many bows can fire together, making numbers and protection central to their role.
After Curare is researched, their arrows also inflict poison damage. Enemies continue to suffer after a hit, giving the archer another way to wear down a target.
